title: Cheap and not as durable as the  cuisinart
text: Cheap and not as durable as the  cuisinart. I got 2 of these and they were both broken.  The plastic yellow housing was chipped or broken off on both of them.  One towards the base of pitcher and the other on the handle (big pieces) when they arrived.  I tried the boiler and it just didn't sound like my cuisinart, no noise to tell you it's done and just goes off soon after it almost boils.  Both of them.
